description: Angular component for configuring target devices in a widget, including form handling, validation, and interaction with widget configuration services.

classes.name: TargetDeviceComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing ControlValueAccessor and Validator for target device configuration in a widget.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback to propagate changes to the form value.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Registers a callback for touch events (not implemented).

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls based on the input.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group and sets up value change subscriptions.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Populates the form with a given TargetDevice object.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form group, returns validation errors if invalid.

methods.name: targetDeviceUpdated
methods.description: Propagates the updated target device value.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Adjusts form validators based on device type and edit mode.
